name: Sudou Kaito
source:
"You're a weirdo."

The reason he entered the school was to find his mother, who he had separated from when he was young. He hopes that she will see him on TV and magazines.

He caught Ichiya's attention at a dance audition one night and entered the school as a scholarship student. Although he may be the most lively and cheerful person in school, his language is a little rough.

Hobby: Dance, Soccer
Favorite Food: Dashi-rolled egg, steamed egg custard
Dislikes: Octopus

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207195018/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char04.htm]official website[/url]]
